edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. in Cant. Prologus 8

source_text: Sponsa in hoc carmine vel ecclesia intellegitur vel anima perfecta. Ecclesia quidem collectio sanctorum; anima vero quae iam Christo sola adhaeret. Et quae de ecclesia dicuntur, ad animam transferri possunt; quae de anima, ad ecclesiam. Sponsus autem Christus est, Verbum Dei, sapientia, pax, iustitia — omnia quae ipse est.
pass_a_gloss: Bride in this song either church is-understood or soul perfect. Church indeed gathering of-saints; soul however which already to-Christ alone cleaves. And what about church are-said, unto soul to-be-transferred can; what about soul, unto church. Bridegroom however Christ is, Word of-God...
pass_b_english: The Bride in this song is understood either as the church or as the perfect soul. The church indeed is the gathering of the saints; the soul is she who already cleaves to Christ alone. And what is said of the church can be transferred to the soul; what of the soul, to the church. But the Bridegroom is Christ, the Word of God, wisdom, peace, justice — all that he himself is.
